title_suffix: two more staged quartets on #2863's shared-kernel words
summary: This package keeps PR2863's (Dugongue) shared-kernel words (PR2857, Lyy-iiis) and adds, as a declared source-bound stage, two more staged quartets (456,457,466,467) and (458,459,464,465) obtained by preload re-synthesis: per call the paid profile changes by {1:+10, 3:-4} and the helper inventory becomes {8:86, 9:232}. A residue-free T74 owner fill (two interleaved copies of the T37 chronology, 666 calls, idle {1:17316, 3:6327, 5:8547, 48:26825}) packs the new inventory. Fresh native chains for both changed words, complete admission and the modern outer release pass; exact kappa = 0.001720184528377469533074 - 1e-46 - 1e-70, above PR2875 by 8.37229605836e-8 and above PR2863/PR2857. No optimality certificate is claimed for the new inventory. Inherited all-size hypotheses remain.

PR2857 (Lyy-iiis, Yiyang Lu) and PR2848 (Lyy-iiis): the staged shared-kernel words, owner/replay tooling and portable admission. PR2843 (mdumitrean): allocation/owner-flow lineage.
